programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E03: El Llamado
programme.desc: La nueva vida de Rebecca parece haber tenido un comienzo maravilloso. Hace poco, se casó con Daniel, un hombre amable y cariñoso que trata a sus dos hijos como si fueran suyos. Pero el secreto de Rebecca amenaza con destruir su feliz hogar. Desde su infancia, ha tenido la capacidad de ver y escuchar espíritus, pero decidió bloquear los intentos que ellos hacen para comunicarse. Rebecca ha mantenido este secreto oculto a todos, incluso a Daniel. Pero unos pocos meses después de su matrimonio, aparece un fantasma, que se niega a ser ignorado. Incapaz de eludir a esa alma inquieta, Rebecca debe poner su confianza en manos de su nuevo esposo, e incorporar su ayuda a sus esfuerzos para encontrar las respuestas necesarias.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E04: El Apartamento
programme.desc: Los recién casados Bill y Myrisa Spencer están a punto de comenzar una nueva vida. Ambos estudian en la universidad, están en camino de cumplir sus sueños y acaban de mudarse a un apartamento que fue renovado hace poco y que se encuentra lejos del bullicioso distrito universitario de la ciudad de Seattle, en el estado de Washington. Pero su nuevo apartamento pronto demuestra ser todo, menos tranquilo. Figuras fantasmales emergen de las sombras para deambular por los pasillos. Incapaces de anular su contrato de arrendamiento, se ven forzados a convivir con los espíritus hasta que una de las entidades ataca a Bill de manera brutal. Desesperados por ayuda, Bill y Myrisa recurren a cazadores de fantasmas de la localidad, en busca de respuestas. La investigación que éstos llevan a cabo revela el pasado violento que desató a las entidades oscuras que amenazan a los Spencer.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E05: Los Espiritus De La Muerte
programme.desc: Joanne y Jim Whitley persiguen su sueño de ser propietarios de un negocio de equitación y comprar una granja abandonada del estado de New Hampshire para tal fin. Ellos renuevan la propiedad con mucho entusiasmo y se preparan para inaugurar. Pero poco después de haber comenzado con el negocio, el hijo pequeño de la pareja escucha sonidos inexplicables y Joanne siente una presencia negativa en las cercanías. Su frustración aumenta a medida que el negocio enfrenta dificultades financieras, debido a que los caballos se ven afectados por ciertas dolencias misteriosas. Y, luego, Joanne en verdad comienza a temerle a lo que no puede ver, en el momento en que la presencia se vuelve física. Cuando la vida de su hijo se ve amenazada, Joanne recurre a un maestro Shamballa, para poder combatir la presencia maligna que está atentando contra su hogar y su familia.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E02: El Despertar
programme.desc: Randy y Marcy viven bajo un estrés real todos los días; ambos trabajan en agencias de la policía. Randy trabaja como detective, mientras que Marcy maneja el centro de llamadas. Pero en 2003, el estrés aumenta cuando el Ejército envía en misión especial a su hijo al Medio Oriente. Marcy se siente abrumada por la preocupación. Cuando alcanza su punto de quiebre emocional, un espíritu latente despierta para amenazarla. Los miedos de Marcy solo sirven para alimentar al espíritu colérico, hasta que éste se vuelve sobrecogedoramente poderoso. Marcy debe luchar para mantener la calma y tratar de encontrar la manera de librar a su hogar de esa presencia maligna antes de ésta la lleve al límite.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E01: Una Ira Siniestra
programme.desc: Los sueños recurrentes constituyen la manera en la que nuestra mente lidia con los problemas que debemos resolver. Pero, ¿qué ocurre cuando la vida comienza a imitar los miedos más temibles del subconsciente... y entonces la realidad y las imágenes oníricas entran en colisión? Pesadillas inquietantes sobre una figura oscura y colérica abruman a Cindy, mientras se prepara para trasladar a su familia a una antigua casa en su ciudad campestre natal. Asumiendo que solo se trata de estrés, Cindy trata de poner a un lado esas noches de inquietud y sigue adelante. Pero terminar de mudarse no alivia el problema... poco después de que Cindy y su familia se instalan en la propiedad, la realidad comienza a reflejar sus pesadillas. Las jóvenes hijas de Cindy temen quedarse en su propia habitación y Cindy no puede evitar la sensación de que alguien, o algo, las está observando desde las sombras. Cuando la presencia del mal se manifiesta para atacar físicamente a Cindy, ella hace acopio de todo su valor y resuelve luchar contra él antes de que llegue hacerle daño a sus seres queridos.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S07E15: La Maldicion De La Momia
programme.desc: Tras un escalofriante encuentro con una momia egipcia, un joven es perseguido por el ente para robarle el alma.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E10: Perseguidos Por El Mal
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy tiene grandes esperanzas para su familia en su nuevo hogar. Pero poco después de que se mudan, una presencia siniestra se manifiesta desde los rincones sombríos de su hogar en el estado de Texas. Al pasar del tiempo, esa presencia concentra su ira en la hermosa hija adolescente de los McCarthy, Caressa. Comienza a atormentarla cada noche en el lugar de la casa donde debería sentirse más segura: en los confines de su propia habitación. A medida que van transcurriendo las noches, el fantasma se torna aún más fuerte y está más resuelto a mantener cautiva a Caressa. Mientras Judy lucha por proteger a sus seres queridos, ella devela un secreto violento que amenaza a todos aquellos a quienes ama.

programme.title: Historias De Ultratumba S04E09: Cazadores De Fantasmas
programme.desc: Stacy Jones ha dedicado su vida a ayudar a otros a comprender y a enfrentar las amenazas paranormales. Como la experta que es, se siente tranquila al permitir que su hijo adolescente, Jamie, se una a ella en una investigación que realizan en un cementerio cercano a su casa, ubicada en el estado de Nueva York. Pero poco después de regresar a la casa, Jamie descubre una extraña marca de rasguños en su pierna. Jaime también escucha ruidos inexplicables que resuenan en la casa y observa cómo algunos objetos vuelan por toda la habitación. Él sabe que ha despertado a una entidad maligna. Cuando Stacey es testigo de cómo un demonio ataca a Jamie, ella recurre a su amigo y colega John Zaffis para salvar a su hijo de una entidad que está dispuesta a poseer su alma.

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Platos Sucios

programme.title: Mercedes Maybach G650 Landaulet
programme.desc: Maybach se asocia a vehículos extravagantes, al lujo y a la artesanía perfecta. Pero en el Salón del Automóvil de Ginebra 2017, el fabricante presenta algo nuevo. Es el momento del Mercedes-Maybach G 650 Landaulet.

programme.title: Pagani Huayra
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos italianos inspiran a jóvenes y mayores. Y en este fascinante mundo, el Pagani Huayra es la gloria que canta.

programme.title: Caterham 620R
programme.desc: El Caterham más malo de la historia. El 620R de 545 kilos es una bestia que da miedo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: McLaren es una de las marcas de automóviles más famosas de Gran Bretaña. Apenas hay coches deportivos que fascinen tanto como un McLaren o que tengan una herencia tan legendaria en el automovilismo. Dos modelos recientes de McLaren son el 650S y la serie limitada P1. Supercars tiene ganas de amar y cita al McLaren 650S en una antigua zona industrial y en la pista de carreras.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hay detalles que diferencian a los supercoches de los coches normales y estos detalles son esenciales. Los supercoches son los coches más grandes, más ruidosos y más caros de la carretera; son obras de arte de cuatro ruedas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: La Dolce Vita - 100 anos de Maserati
programme.desc: Para celebrar su centenario, Maserati se ha premiado a sí misma con un precioso coupé llamado Maserati Alfiere. Pero eso no es todo. La compañía invita a un viaje de Bolonia a Turín con los modelos más bellos de las últimas décadas. Supercars participa en este viaje con un Granturismo MC Stradale.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se llama Mulsanne, Bentely Mulsanne. El nuevo buque insignia de Bentley alcanza una velocidad máxima cercana a los 300 km/h, es lujoso como un hotel de primera clase y elegante como un traje de Armani. Supercars revela qué se siente al conducir un coche de ensueño como éste. Además: Supercars echa un vistazo al extraordinario Rolls Royce Ghost y al coupé de alta tecnología Mercedes S 63 AMG.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: El lujo no significa necesariamente perder el tiempo. El híbrido es una de las técnicas que promete un menor consumo de combustible con un motor aún potente. Lexus es el pionero en la electrificación de los coches. Supercars conduce el nuevo LS 600h, el BMW Actiev Hybrid 7 y el Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: La Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse, en Austria, es el terreno de juego ideal para los ligeros Lotus Elise y Roding Roadster. Estos dos roadsters están pegados a la calle y, por tanto, son muy divertidos de conducir.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupé
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupé es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensación de volar.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Las limusinas británicas son la encarnación del lujo, son la clase alta del automóvil. Construidas con los materiales más exclusivos, estas limusinas como el Rolls Royce Phantom, el Bentley Mulsanne o el Jaguar XJ combinan lujo, confort y potencia.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Los superdeportivos británicos como el Aston Martin Vanquish, el Bentley Continental GT Speed o el P1 de McLaren están entre los deportivos más espectaculares y bellos del mundo. No se trata sólo de potencia, sino también de gracia y estilo.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Con su diseño vanguardista, tecnología superior y placer de conducción, los coupés alemanes como el Porsche 911, el Mercedes Clase S Coupé, el BMW Serie 6 o el Audi RS5 encarnan la pasión por la conducción.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Con los proporciones impresionantes, motores únicos y un estilo italiano inigualable, los deportivos descapotables como el Ferrari 488 Spyder, el Lamborghini Aventador Roadster o el Maserati Gran Cabrio ofrecen "grande emozione".

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Lujo, estilo de vida y exclusividad, ningún otro coche transporta estos atributos mejor que los SUV de Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo e Infinity. Estos SUV, elegantes y excelentemente equipados, encarnan el espíritu de las ganas de vivir.

programme.title: Lamborghini Gallardo
programme.desc: ¿De dónde viene la leyenda del nombre Lamborghini Gallardo? Francisco Gallardo fue un famoso criador de toros de lidia en el siglo XVIII. Una de las cinco razas principales lleva su nombre, al igual que la Superbiest italiana sobre ruedas.

programme.title: Corvette C7 Descapotable
programme.desc: Probamos exhaustivamente el Chevrolet Corvette C7 Descapotable en las montañas.

programme.title: Cadillac Series 62 Convertible
programme.desc: El Cadillac Serie 62 Convertible de 1949 establece nuevos estándares en términos de lujo.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL Construcción ligera
programme.desc: Tuvimos la suerte de probar uno de los 29 Mercedes 300 SL "mariposa" construidos para su primera carrera de la Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Maserati Gran Turismo Coupe Stradale
programme.desc: La asunción de riesgos y la precisión son dos características que no sólo se reflejan en la agitada historia de la empresa Maserati. El Maserati Gran Turismo también los interioriza de forma sorprendente.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn
programme.desc: Conducir un descapotable es una de las cosas más agradables durante los meses de verano. También lo es conducir un Rolls-Royce. La combinación de ambos es ciertamente difícil de superar. El Rolls Royce Dawn ofrece esa experiencia.

programme.title: Alpina B5
programme.desc: El Audi RS6 y el Mercedes E63 AMG son dos mejores deportivos. BMW parece haber abandonado la carrera, pero el sintonizador de alto rendimiento Alpina presentó el B5 Twin Turbo, su respuesta basada en BMW a la fuerte competencia.

programme.title: Rimac Concept One
programme.desc: El coche eléctrico más rápido, potente y caro del mundo. Este superdeportivo no se ajusta a la norma. El futurista Rimac Concept One es extremadamente plano y potente. Aunque el coche es relativamente pesado, la capacidad de aceleración es enorme.

programme.title: Infiniti QX30
programme.desc: Diseño moderno, dimensiones compactas y bajo consumo de combustible. El QX30 cumple estos requisitos. El diseño es especialmente importante para ello. Su forma redondeada y robusta lo diferencia claramente de los SUV convencionales.

programme.title: VW Crafter
programme.desc: La VW Crafter: un vehículo con muchísimos usos. Junto a la Flatbed, la furgoneta es la eterna favorita. Hay tres distancias entre ejes diferentes, con tracción delantera, trasera o total.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: Con sus coches V8, los estadounidenses demostraron a finales de los años 60 que también podían construir coches ganadores. El Ford GT 40 es uno de estos coches. Al principio, el proyecto "Victory at Le Mans" de Ford USA amenazaba con fracasar.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini se fijó el objetivo de construir los mejores coches deportivos del mundo, un movimiento audaz, al estar situado a pocos kilómetros de Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Después de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, siguiendo los pasos de su padre, que había sido responsable del desarrollo del clásico Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche sentó las bases de los modelos deportivos de la marca, como el 356 y el Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: No se puede hablar de rallyes sin mencionar el nombre de Walter Röhrl. Röhrl demostró su talento en los rallies desde muy joven y ganó varios campeonatos europeos, mundiales y otros internacionales a lo largo de su carrera.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: A lo largo de su dilatada carrera, Hans-Joachim Stuck no sólo ganó varias veces la Fórmula II y varios campeonatos internacionales de turismos, sino también las famosas 24 horas de Le Mans en dos ocasiones.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: Con sus coches V8, los estadounidenses demostraron a finales de los años 60 que también podían construir coches ganadores. El Ford GT 40 es uno de estos coches. Al principio, el proyecto "Victory at Le Mans" de Ford USA amenazaba con fracasar.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Jaguar y Land Rover están experimentando una transformación bajo el paraguas del grupo indio Tata. Jaguar se rejuvenece y Land Rover se amplía con nuevos modelos. Mostramos la cuerda floja entre tradición e innovación.

programme.title: Made In...

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You've got the ring on your finger, but are you really ready to walk down that aisle? Dr. Phil continues his three-part series, putting relationships to the test as three engaged couples compete against each other in real-life challenges about teamwork, money, children, in-laws, personal space and sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nichole claims her husband gets violent when he drinks which he denies. And, Theresa and Steve say their son Steven’s rage is out of control, and they fear for their lives. Plus, two victims of a road rage incident caught on tape share their story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can May-December romances really last? Christopher Knight, famous for his role as Peter on The Brady Bunch, and Adrianne Curry, winner on America's Next Top Model, began their relationship when they starred together on the reality show The Surreal Life 4, and the public watched as they planned their wedding on their own show, My Fair Brady. Now they both say their 24-year age difference is a huge problem in their chaotic marriage. Adrianne says Christopher treats her like an employee, and Christopher says if she worked for him, she would’ve been fired a long time ago. Can these two work out their generational differences? Then, 38-year-old Shelly wants to know if it’s wrong to be in a relationship with an 18-year-old friend of her son. She says he makes her feel beautiful, but wonders if she’s causing him or her children harm. Dr. Phil doesn’t mince words when he tells her his opinion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with Charles and Tracy. After coming to the conclusion that his dream of being shared by his wife and mistress was never going to happen, did Charles follow through and end his relationship with the other woman?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Should transgender athletes be allowed to compete with those of the gender they identify with or must they only compete with athletes who share the gender they were assigned at birth? Are laws that ban transgender women from participating in women's sports fair? LGBTQ+ activists have described criteria limiting transgender athlete involvement in gendered sports as "discriminatory.” Lia Thomas made headline news and stirred debate when she competed in swimming nationals as a transgender woman. Dr. Phil, along with Layne Ingram, a transgender man and basketball coach, and Olympic swimmer Nancy Hogshead-Makar, an advocate for girls and women in sports and CEO of Champion Women, discuss what they believe is right and fair. Then, Riley Gaines, who competed against Lia Thomas, gives her perspective on how she felt after their race. The big question is: what does the science say? Harvard professor Dr. Carole Hooven breaks it down.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Revisiting the 1992 murder of Shanda Sharer, her family reflects on coping and forgiveness.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year and are already wondering if it’s time to call it quits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A divorced couple secretly remarries, but did they make a mistake- again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lisa says her four beautiful adult daughters, Brandi, Wendi, Laci and Tahni, are "monsters" who pick on her, and their constant drama is tearing apart their family. However, all four daughters say it's Lisa who needs help. They claim she's a "textbook narcissist" who constantly plays the victim and has always put men before her family. Who is in the wrong here? Will Dr. Phil be able to bring this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there something you’ve been hanging on to for just a little too long? Clothes you haven’t fit into since high school? Boxes of stuff you haven’t looked at in years? Dr. Phil’s guests say their loved ones need to call the junk yard and “Get rid of it!” Kim says her husband, Paul’s, Star Warshobby has to go. With over 6,000 pieces in his collection, Paul spends 30 hours a week playing with his action figures, building models and talking to friends about Star Wars. He even had a light saber sword fight at their wedding, so shouldn’t Kim have known what she was getting into? Next, Larry and Sheila married four months ago, but Sheila says she had no idea she was getting hitched to a hoarder. Larry says she’s got it all wrong -– she’s the pack rat! With some of their favorite collections rolled out on stage, can Dr. Phil help them negotiate what goes and what stays? Plus, meet Terri, who has four storage units and two garages full of sentimental memories -– like a rubber chicken and her father’s spine X-rays! She spends so much money storing her stuff, that she can’t even afford health insurance. What’s at the heart of her hoarding? Don’t miss this hilarious look at how collections can get out of control!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Bad Boy Blake with Abs of Steel
programme.desc: Blake, 26, abandons his education to smoke pot all day in his mother's rent-free house, where he is verbally abusive and refuses to work.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you or your spouse a gadget junkie? One woman says that her husband is having an affair with his cell phone and she is fed up! He spends hours a day on personal calls, but fails to communicate with his family. Will he finally agree to hang up his phone and talk to his wife? Another guest is so addicted to TV that it’s ruining his marriage. He has 7 televisions turned on at all times and his teenage kids are following his bad example. Can Dr. Phil peel these couch potatoes away from the TV set for one day?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil posed the question on Twitter, "What are your biggest in-law problems, complaints and issues?" and the response was overwhelming! And in a recent poll, one quarter of divorced couples report that in-laws are "somewhat" responsible for their marriages ending. You may not believe it, but finding a way to get along with your mother-in-law is crucial for the long-term success of your marriage.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: We've all heard of in-laws who don't get along, but these guests say their problems have become scary and even life-threatening.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In-laws can be the kind who give unwanted advice, stop by unexpectedly and use guilt and manipulation to get what they want. But sometimes, they are loving parents who get caught in the middle of their child's relationship. Amanda calls her mother-in-law, Yolande, psychotic, controlling and meddling. She says Yolande speaks to her son, Pierre, in French so she can hide the hurtful words she’s using about Amanda. Yolande says Amanda is a drunk, and an uneducated woman who is wrecking her son's life. Why does Pierre say he can't choose a side? To test Amanda's theory of why Yolande and Pierre speak French to each other, Dr. Phil sets up a "special" dinner for the three of them. Be a fly on the wall, and find out if Amanda's right or just being paranoid. And, John and Chrissy's engagement is on hold because they say they can't stop fighting. They hit and slap each other, and call each other vulgar names — often in front of their 8-month-old son. John's mom, Charlene, who is often pulled into their fights, says they both need to grow up! After watching themselves scream and yell on tape, will this couple decide to drop their fists, close their mouths and work to make a peaceful home for their baby?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Guests claim their pregnancies have lasted well over 9 months– Shayna for one year and Zona for more than three-and-a-half years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kalie, Susan, and Gabby say they want to shutdown Hephzibah House, a Christian boarding school they were forced to attend as teens. They say they believe the girls in that home are at great risk, but another former student, Lucinda, says these women need to stop all the allegations because the home was a safe haven for her and many other girls. You won’t want to miss this conclusion as a former volunteer staff member joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

John insists that the child porn was accidentally downloaded, and while he admits to exchanging emails with men online, he maintains that he never met up with anyone in person. How does he explain his actions? And, what will the results of a polygraph test reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The 237 Reasons Why Women Have Sex
programme.desc: "I wanted to make someone jealous." "I was bored." "I wanted to feel closer to God." These are just a few of the 237 reasons why women say they have sex. Author and clinical psychologist Dr. Cindy Meston and Dr. Jennifer Berman, a sexual health expert, join Dr. Phil to talk about women and sex, and offer advice to couples with differing libidos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Hoarder Father and His Bug Infested Home!
programme.desc: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Hoarder Mom: Her Kids Or Her Clutter
programme.desc: Chandra and her siblings, Charity, Perry and Preston, say their mother, Pamela’s, hoarding is so out of control that nearly every inch of her 9,000-square-foot home is filled with “junk.” The siblings say that growing up, Pamela would pick through their garbage to save items, which forced them to sneak trash out of the house. They say as they got older, her hoarding became progressively worse, prompting them to stage an intervention in 2012, which escalated to the point of police being called. Pamela says she feels her family unfairly “ganged up” on her and insists she’s not a hoarder -- so, how does she explain the mess? Plus, Pamela’s husband, Richard, moved out of the house two years ago -- he says because of the hoarding, but she says otherwise. Hear why Pamela claims Richard is equally to blame for the family’s problems. Can Dr. Phil help Pamela get rid of her clutter -- and help this family get back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine discovering that your next-door neighbor owns over 200 cats. Ray and Dennis never thought their neighbor, Kristy, would let her pet collection get that big. Once friends, the three are now in a nasty and vindictive war because of the felines. Ray and Dennis say Kristy's property is one big, disgusting litter box, and they want Kristy to get rid of her cats. Kristy says she'll never part with her "cat sanctuary." Are Ray and Dennis playing dirty in order to run Kristy out of town? When is it too much, and where do you draw the line in the litter box? programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.desc: Angelica says John "checks her" for signs of cheating every time she comes home. She wants a lie detector test to prove she's been faithful! Then, Ashley she found out that her boyfriend, TJ, had cheated on her when she was 8 months pregnant.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Two years ago, Sharon gained custody of her daughter Megan and James’ child due to James’ abusive behavior. Megan admitted to him kicking her in the stomach while pregnant, but now says he is a changed man. Can they prove it to Sharon and Steve?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Your Kids Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Debbie is concerned that her daughter, Heather, is so preoccupied with breaking up her relationship, that she is neglecting her children. Plus, Stephen is here because he's concerned that his daughters are being abused by his ex-wife's boyfriend.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Terry is accused of raping Angie’s young daughter and Angie allegedly witnessed this heinous incident. The child is now in the custody of her father Larry and his wife Angela, who are determined to get justice for her! Can Steve get to the truth?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: She Gave Birth 5 Days Ago, Am I The Father?
programme.desc: Sabrionna has been waiting to return for a DNA and lie detector test to prove that Anthony’s the father and she has been faithful to him! Then, Patrick returns to prove that he’s not the father of Angel’s baby while her man Dale fumes!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: I Want Justice for My Daughter
programme.desc: Cassey believes she recently uncovered her ex-husband Calvin’s evil deeds, which he was trying to cover up with gifts for his daughter, but did he actually molest her daughter? Or has she had it all wrong?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Did You Not Hear the Results?
programme.desc: Pam suffered two miscarriages from the stress of her boyfriend Miguel’s cheating accusations. Felisha confessed to cheating on her boyfriend Natron, but Natron denies fathering her two kids. The truth shall set some of these guests free!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Chris fears that his girlfriend is still sleeping with her abusive ex; Quay thinks constant arguments over cheating caused her to miscarry her twins; Raena says her man accuses her of cheating with every man she happens to be around.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends—DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine—are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: Condemn
programme.desc: College student, Quan, is presented with an opportunity too good to turn down. When she lets her sister, Bree, in on the deal, she takes it to the next level. Soon Quan realizes they both are in too deep, and is faced with the consequences.

programme.title: Choppa City Queens
programme.desc: Best friends Leah, Jada and Shanice lose their jobs, are unable to find new work, and struggling to make ends meet. One day, Leah comes across a gunrunner hiding a bag of AK-47’s. Leah strikes up a deal with him to buy his guns and sell them on the black-market. Things start going well with the women selling guns until Shanice’s boyfriend, Marquis, finds out the truth. Marquis and his cousin Berg then decide they are going to steal the guns from the woman and set up their own operation.

programme.title: Gutta Mamis
programme.desc: Shinette and Tierra have always vowed to ride-or-die for one another. So when opportunity knocks, it's time to do what they do best — get to the bag! It was supposed to go down like all of the others, except this time, they walk away from the scene with a body on their hands. As long as Tierra sticks to the script and doesn't utter a word, there's nothing to worry about. But once fear and desperation seep in, it's not long before she finds herself confiding in her on-again-off-again boyfriend, Duke — breaking her pact and setting off a chain of events that leaves every woman for herself. Their chase to get the bag, just might land them inside of one!

programme.title: Forever Single
programme.desc: The Dawkins Brothers are back! 3 Brothers living together are in a wild adventure when Hercules has a crazy baby mama who gets her detective dad to force Hercules to take care of his responsibilities by any means necessary.

programme.title: Loyalty
programme.desc: When independent drug dealer, Buttons, learns his girlfriend used to be his competitor, T Bones, longtime side chick, and believes they might still be messing around, it's on. T Bones' family is strong and makes sure no one crosses them by any means.

programme.title: Loyalty 2: The Return of T Bone
programme.desc: After making bail, the notorious killer and drug lord T Bone returns to the streets of Harlem, NY to clean up the family business and tie all loose ends. But once again the tables are turned when T Bone is betrayed by someone close.

programme.title: Predatory Behavior
programme.desc: When women start disappearing all over the city, Detective Powell and Scott take on the case hoping to bring the culprit to justice. Can they find the elusive killer or will it be to late for the next victim.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: Tethered Hearts
programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who’s inherited his father’s iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When a shady music executive starts to recruit his talent, he fights to keep his club afloat.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter’s life grows more personal and more urgent.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.desc: Hot undergrad, Mindy, pulls her married professor out of his squaresville life and takes him on the road for some groovy adventures in this quintessential 70s sex farce that includes drag races, pot, hippies, and erotic encounters.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.sub-title: US Open 2023 – Men’s Pro Singles Gold Medal – Hunter Johnson vs Yates Johnson
programme.desc: Experience the thrilling showdown at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships as twin brothers Hunter Johnson and Yates Johnson face off for the very first time in the men's pro singles gold medal match. Both top seeds with years of experience playing doubles together, these brothers bring a unique dynamic filled with expert strategy, rapid exchanges, and emotional rivalry. From early leads and tactical shot-making to late-game drama and camaraderie, watch Hunter and Yates battle it out point by point in a historic and captivating final. Featuring expert commentary and insights into their playing styles, this match is a must-watch for pickleball fans everywhere.

programme.sub-title: NPL 2024 – Women’s Doubles Championship – Carter & Ojeda vs Zelenski & Kordic Mueller
programme.desc: The stakes are sky-high in this 2024 National Pickleball League Women’s Doubles Championship as the Coachella Valley Scorpions' dynamic duo, Molly Carter and Kelly Ojeda, take on the formidable Denver Iconics pairing of Stacy Zelenski and Lily Kordic Mueller. programme.title: Giorgio Piola: Illustrating Speed
programme.desc: For nearly 50 years Giorgio Piola has been the foremost technical journalist in Formula 1. He has attended more Grands Prix than anyone in history. This film looks at the remarkable career of this legend.

programme.title: Behind The Visor with Nico Hülkenberg
programme.desc: He may have taken 3 years out of full-time F1, but Nico Hülkenberg certainly hasn't lost the motivation to push himself. Earlier in the year, we caught up with the Hulk himself, where Nico opens up on his early retirement the first time around, his comeback with Haas and his future with Audi in F1. He also talks to GP Racing about his life, what drives him and what is really important outside of F1. For this interview, we partnered with our sister team GP Racing Magazine. Check out the link below to read the extended interview with Nico and more exclusive articles! www.gpracing.com

programme.title: Seven ways F1 teams covered up tobacco advertising
programme.desc: Ferrari and McLaren both changed branding on their cars for the Australian Grand Prix, due to complaints about their links to tobacco companies. That brought back memories of when several teams on the grid carried full-on tobacco sponsorship, and they would have to change their liveries when racing in countries where cigarette sponsorship was outlawed. In this video we take a look back at seven popular methods that were used by teams during this period.

programme.title: Nine times F1 drivers lost maiden victories
programme.desc: Charles Leclerc’s heartbreaking lost victory in the Bahrain Grand Prix brought back memories of other times in Formula 1 history that drivers missed out on a maiden win. In this list we take a look at some of the most painful of those stories, and the variety of reasons that robbed drivers of their first chance to stand on the top step of an F1 podium.

programme.title: Five moments that shaped F1's first 1000 races
programme.desc: Formula 1 celebrates the 1000th world championship race this weekend in China, and to kick off the festivities we're looking back at races from its history that have defined the way F1 has changed over the years. Join Edd Straw and Stuart Codling from the paddock in Shanghai to take a journey through some of the most important moments that have got us to the 1000th race

programme.title: Top 10 Senna Moments
programme.desc: Qualifying performances from "another dimension"; thrashing his rivals repeatedly in torrential wet conditions; doing whatever it took to win the world championship at all costs. Ayrton Senna's too-brief time in Formula 1 was a colourful tapestry of brilliant driving and high-stakes controversy. On the 25th anniversary of his tragic crash at Imola, Autosport brings you the most unforgettable moments of the late Brazilian's F1 career.

programme.title: MLMC 2025: Round 5 - Silverstone Highlights
programme.desc: Catch all the highlights from the fifth round of the Michelin Le Mans Cup at Silverstone.

programme.title: Super Formula 2025 | Round 4: Motegi - Race
programme.desc: Watch the fourth race of the 2025 Super Formula championship season at Mobility Resort Motegi.

programme.title: Too Fast To Race
programme.desc: By the early 1980s the 'Group B’ class had become the ‘Godzilla’ of the rally scene. The legacy of Group B, however, is a whole range of spectacular cars that continue to thrill enthusiasts. We look at some of the giants of the class.

programme.title: Nigel Mansell: Il Leone
programme.desc: In this exclusive interview with Peter Windsor, Nigel talks about his career, his life and what drives him to the edge of everything that matters.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 2
programme.desc: The bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal’s longest stage, a 655 km route from Grândola to Badajoz, delivered high drama on Thursday. Red Bull KTM’s Daniel Sanders edged Tosha Schareina in RallyGP, while teammate Edgar Canet extended his Rally2 lead. France’s Thomas Zoldos (Rally3) and Gaëtan Martinez (quads) dominated their classes, and João Ferreira (Toyota) claimed a breakthrough Ultimate win over mentor Carlos Sainz. Dacia endured setbacks as Nasser Al-Attiyah and Sébastien Loeb lost significant time. Portugal celebrated a historic triple in FIA categories with Ferreira, Gonçalo Guerreiro (Challenger), and Alexandre Pinto (SSV). Stage 3 will cover 511 km around Badajoz on Friday.

programme.title: Volkswagen ID.R - A year of electric records
programme.desc: It was an exciting year for the Volkswagen ID.R team and Romain Dumas. From the Goodwood festival of Speed to the Tianmen Mountain, no record was left unbroken, watch the action unfold in the official documentary.

programme.title: Leclerc Looks Back at Highlights from his F1 Career
programme.desc: Charles Leclerc has had some huge moments in his career, from spectacular wins to helping the team develop even before he raced for Ferrari's F1 team. We sat down with Leclerc and brought him 5 photos from his career, asking him to pinpoint where he was and why each photo is so special to him.

programme.title: Episode 1: £500 Bike Challenge
programme.desc: In the first episode we have part one of the Motorcycle Olympics where each presenter has £500 to spend on a Motorbike and complete a range of tasks, if they can even get them started. Graham tests the Livewire, an electric bike from Harley Davison and who better to join him then the man who has ridden more mile on one then anyone else in the world, Charley Boorman. To finish off the episodes Bruce get’s his hands on the MV Agusta Rush and falls in love with the sound.

programme.title: WRT: 24 Hours of Le Mans and Spa
programme.desc: WRT stepped onto the global stage with two of the world’s most prestigious motorsport events. The team entered a formidable lineup at Le Mans, fielding four cars: two Hypercars and two GT3s, alongside five M4 GT3 Evos for the 24 Hours of Spa. Follow the team’s journey as they tackle these demanding races head-on.

programme.title: Rainer Schlegelmilch: Freezing Speed
programme.desc: In a Motorsport Network exclusive, this new film gives an incredible insight into the working life of Rainer Schlegelmilch, who is the only photographer to have been honoured with a lifetime F1 photographers accreditation.

programme.title: Porsche Cup Brasil 2025 | Round 5: Portimão - Endurance Race (EN) |
programme.desc: Watch the endurance race of the fifth round of the 2025 Porsche Carrera Cup Brasil season at Autódromo Internacional do Algarve.

programme.title: The 10 Best British F1 Drivers Of All Time
programme.desc: With the 70th Anniversary Grand Prix taking place at Silverstone this weekend, we thought we’d take a look at some of the greatest F1 drivers to ever come out of Great Britain.

programme.title: When Indycar Conquered F1 - Monzanapolis
programme.desc: Using the 2.6 mile oval circuit at Monza, Indycar and Formula 1 came together in the 1950's for an epic race showdown, but even with Ferrari and Jaguar leading the pack for the European teams, they were still outpaced by the Americans. In the latest episode in our “Short View Back to the Past” series, Chief Editor Kevin Turner looks at when Indycar conquered F1.

programme.title: The Most Dominant Race Win In Modern F1
programme.desc: Winning margins in Formula 1 are usually measured in seconds. Occasionally, in a wet race, we get a race won by more than a minute. But sometimes we’ve needed another unit of measurement altogether. In the latest of Autosport’s “Short View Back to the Past” series, Chief Editor Kevin Turner looks at when Damon Hill won by two laps…

programme.title: Gearing Up 2025 - Episode 9: Monster Jam & the TransAnatolia
programme.desc: Welcome to the ninth episode of Gearing Up for 2025! It’s the TV series that takes you around the globe, following the hottest action from some of the world’s most unique competitions. High skills, passion for technology, impatience for innovation, and pure love for adrenaline, are combined at their best. So, start your engines, tighten your seat belts, and get ready to feel the G-force with some serious action! From the raw horsepower and roaring crowds of Monster Jam, we dive into the endurance and grit of the TransAnatolia 2025, one of the most demanding cross-country rallies on the planet. The journey continues to Arendal, showcasing the Nordic spirit of motorsport where precision meets power. To cap it off, viewers get an exclusive first look at the upcoming Hellas Rally Raid 24h, promising relentless action across the Greek terrain. Each segment highlights the extremes of man, machine, and nature colliding in pursuit of speed and glory. And that’s a wrap on the ninth episode of Gearing Up 2025!

programme.title: 2024-2025 ALMS: Round 5 - 4 Hours of Abu Dhabi
programme.desc: Algarve Pro Racing dominated the first race in Abu Dhabi, securing a dramatic 1-2 finish after a thrilling final-lap overtake.

programme.title: Roaring To Victory - Jaguar
programme.desc: After an absence of almost three decades, Jaguar returned to top flight sportscar racing in 1985. This is the action-packed story of how the legendary British marque roared back to victory. Archive race footage traces the full story of how Tom Walkinshaw Racing took Jaguar to the top, claiming World Championship success and securing Jaguar's first victory at the Le Mans 24 Hours for 31 years. This film features highlights from the road to victory, from the debut of the XJR-6 at Canada's Mosport in August 1985 through to the 1988 Le Mans triumph of the XJR-9LM. You'll see the Tony Southgate-designed Jaguars in action at iconic circuits like Spa, Silverstone, Monza, Fuji and, of course, the Circuit de la Sarthe, from 1985, '86, '87 and '88. There's fabulous race highlights, including in-car footage, featuring Jaguar racing greats including Derek Warwick, Eddie Cheever, Martin Brundle, Jan Lammers, Raul Boesel, John Watson, Johnny Dumfries, Andy Wallace, Jean-Louis Schlesser and more. There's interviews with many of these stars, plus contributions from Tom Walkinshaw and Jaguar chairman Sir John Egan. Roaring to Victory is the comprehensive story of three incredible years.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Prologue
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal kicked off in Grândola with a 5 km prologue, marking the start of its second edition. Daniel Sanders (Red Bull KTM) claimed his 20th special win in RallyGP, while Edgar Canet (Rally2), Thomas Zoldos (Rally3), and Antanas Kanopkinas (quads) also took victories. FIA leader Nasser Al Attiyah (Dacia) repeated his 2024 prologue win ahead of Toyota’s Lucas Moraes and João Ferreira, while Carlos Sainz (Ford) finished last in class. Portuguese fans celebrated local triumphs from Gonçalo Guerreiro (Challenger) and Alexandre Pinto (SSV). Stage 1, a 425 km loop around Grândola, begins on Wednesday at 8:05 am (UTC+1).

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 1
programme.desc: Stage 1 of the bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal saw fierce battles on a 425 km loop around Grândola. Red Bull KTM’s Daniel Sanders (RallyGP) and Edgar Canet (Rally2) doubled up on their prologue wins, while Thomas Zoldos repeated in Rally3 and Gaëtan Martinez took the quad lead. In cars, Henk Lategan (Toyota) claimed the stage and overall lead ahead of four fellow Toyotas, as Nasser Al Attiyah (Dacia) slipped to eighth after a penalty. Mattias Ekström (Challenger) and Alexandre Pinto (SSV) also triumphed. Stage 2 heads into Spain with the week’s longest test: 655 km, including 429 against the clock.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 2
programme.desc: The bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal’s longest stage, a 655 km route from Grândola to Badajoz, delivered high drama on Thursday. Red Bull KTM’s Daniel Sanders edged Tosha Schareina in RallyGP, while teammate Edgar Canet extended his Rally2 lead. France’s Thomas Zoldos (Rally3) and Gaëtan Martinez (quads) dominated their classes, and João Ferreira (Toyota) claimed a breakthrough Ultimate win over mentor Carlos Sainz. Dacia endured setbacks as Nasser Al-Attiyah and Sébastien Loeb lost significant time. Portugal celebrated a historic triple in FIA categories with Ferreira, Gonçalo Guerreiro (Challenger), and Alexandre Pinto (SSV). Stage 3 will cover 511 km around Badajoz on Friday.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 3
programme.desc: Yesterday in Badajoz, Daniel Sanders deprived Tosha Schareina of a coveted home win by just 4 seconds, but the Spaniard got his own back today, edging out the Australian at the end of a lengthy duel. "Chucky" fought gallantly despite having to open the course but had to yield near the finish. Schareina secured his first win since stage 5 of the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge by 3′18″ and rocketed into the overall lead. The two favourites are now 1′42″ apart in the race for the trophy. "Chucky", who had remained undefeated since the start of the bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal, was reminded that all good things must come to an end. Tomorrow, he will set out to take back control from the new leader, who will be leading the charge on the road to Lisbon.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 4
programme.desc: Tosha Schareina, the only man who had managed to beat Daniel Sanders this week, started the special with an overall lead of 1′42″. The Spaniard was leading the charge following his stage win yesterday, so he played it safe and managed to limit the damage to a 50-second deficit to the Australian 248 km into the 274 course. All that changed when he took the wrong turn a few minutes later, a blunder that came with a hefty price tag of 4′54″ lost to Sanders, who moved back into the hot seat. 3′12″ now separate "Chucky" and Schareina going into the finale, where the Spaniard faces an almost unsurmountable task. The man from Oz could be hours away from securing the RallyGP world championship. He just needs to finish on the podium of the race. Another point of interest is the scrap for third place in the bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal, with Luciano Benavides and Ricky Brabec just 10 seconds apart this morning. The Argentinian was 5′11″ slower than his teammate Sanders today, but it was still better than the American, who lost 5′52″ and now sits 51 seconds from Benavides in the standings. KTM hold the advantage over Honda in the battle for both the top and the bottom steps of the podium.

programme.title: W2RC 2025: Rally Raid Portugal Stage 5
programme.desc: Daniel Sanders will forever be remembered as the first rider to claim the RallyGP title before the last event of the series. The Australian, who had been going from strength to strength in the three previous rounds, took it up to the fourth dimension in Lisbon. He crossed the finish line with 3′40″ to spare over runner-up Tosha Schareina (Monster Energy Honda HRC), who proved unable to defend his title. "Chucky", who nabbed four specials out of six, is the fourth rider to sit on the FIM throne in rally raids, following Sam Sunderland (2022), Luciano Benavides (2023) and Ross Branch (2024). His stats are out of this world, including records for the most RallyGP specials won in a single season (15 out of 31, ongoing) and overall (23). The only box left for him to tick this year is to win the Rallye du Maroc and complete a Grand Slam in 2025. Luciano Benavides put the cherry on the cake for KTM with the stage win and third place in the bp Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal (+12′41″), defeating the Honda factory rider Ricky Brabec (+14′34″) and moving up to second in the championship. An epic fight for the silver medal awaits in Morocco, with a mere 3 points separating Benavides, Schareina and Brabec. Ignacio Cornejo, sixth among the W2RC entrants in Portugal, flew the flag for Hero MotoSports, while Bradley Cox did the same for Sherco TVS Rally Factory in eighth place.

programme.title: Artist's Academy presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: A dull tool is a dangerous tool when it comes to woodworking. George Vondriska shares his top tips for sharpening your woodworking tools so you can ensure the cleanest cuts and get the most out of your blades. From lathe chisels to router bits, George explains the steps you'll need to take to keep your tools as sharp as your skills in part two of this two-part lesson.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Learn how to put things together with piecing techniques. Catherine Cureton shows how to strip piece to save time. She cuts and sews strips together, then sub cuts before assembling into blocks. Next, Laura Hartrich creates pieced modern letters, making a whole alphabet with just three blocks. The machine tip segment features Eliane Bergmann demonstrating walking foot curves.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.sub-title: Bonus: Top 3 Free-Motion Quilting Designs Even Beginners Can Do
programme.desc: Machine quilting isn't always as easy as it looks, but anyone can do these three free-motion quilting designs (promise)! Learn how wavy lines, starburst designs, and simple cursive words can turn your quilt into a work of art.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: All quilters can get stuck in a creative rut, even Angela. This week, she turns to strip piecing and her fun, easy-to-piece chevron pattern to get her quilting mojo back. Plus, she'll show you how to use negative space to bring your quilt to life.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Take your sewing to superstar level with tips and tricks guaranteed to give a professional look. Ellen March starts with reader mail and their top tips. Then, meet Mary Roediger from the wool council. Learn all about wool, its properties and qualities and how to use it best in your next project. We finish another tank top from Angela Wolf. Create a festive one shoulder ruffle for an entirely new look.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Sewing experts offer easy ways to create neat sewing projects right at home. Viewers of all skill levels learn tips and techniques for creating professional-looking garments, personalized apparel and home accents. Weekly episodes feature various themes, and feature two main projects and one shorter technique segment. Some projects include monogramming napkins and towels; baby poncho, hooded towel and baby-friendly diapers; embellishing yoga pants with a clothing tattoo; and sewing on knits.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Today's theme is shape it. Use these techniques to form shapes that give structure and interest to your jewelry projects. programme.desc: Every occasion no matter how big or small deserves a card – and today we've got designs for everyday occasions. Lots of cards and ingredients in one Scrapbook Soup.

programme.desc: The definition of a shadow is a dark image projected onto a surface when light is blocked by the shade of an object. It's what gives your project dimension. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Love Shriners
programme.desc: Dynamic Media Partners - Shriners - PP SHFFT8CGTH

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.
